author: Matt Lenzie
upstream_repository_access: Private; public reproducibility begins from included aggregate inputs.json
scope: The fixed England and Wales Price Paid extract contains 61,717 Q3 2026 records, with a latest transaction date of 28 August. Its 29.27% ratio to recorded Q3 2025 transactions is not a measured completeness percentage or a market decline. The report examines property mix, regional mapping and publication lag. Recent new-build shares remain blank, not zero; 14 Q3 transactions lack regional mapping. No nowcast or constant-quality price estimate is supplied.
reproduction: python reproduce.py --output reproduced; standard library only. Does not rebuild upstream ETL or independently recalculate retained source statistics.
no_private_entities: No lender names, security trustees, company numbers, borrower records, addresses or transaction-level records included.
